answer_2.quote: We use Precision-at-1 (P@1), Mean Average Precision (MAP), and Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR)... We also compute the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and Kendall's Tau-b correlation...

answer_4.quote: From the retrieved documents, all candidate sentences are extracted and ranked... top candidates for each question are manually assessed as correct or incorrect by human judges.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators judge whether each answer candidate is correct or incorrect.
